data_fields.name: buff_duration
data_fields.donor_constant: per power: 1800 s (armour2, shield2), 900 s (armour1, shield1), 30-360 s for the rest seen in grep (receipts only for armour2)

data_fields.name: combat_haste_clamp
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (duration = speed x (1 - haste/100), unclamped)

best_idea: Charge a power's resource only after its effect is accepted, make a self buff a toggle that costs nothing to switch off, and regenerate the pool on a timer that re-arms only while below max and runs three times faster while meditating.
decision_why: Charge-after-accept, free toggle-off and meditation regen fit a focus pool for row 13 specials; drop the light/dark council cost table and fix the negative rounding and unclamped haste.
acceptance: A focus special refused at 0 focus costs nothing; a second use of an active self buff costs nothing and removes it; a meditating player gains 15 focus every 5 s at regen 10 and stops at max; a standing player gains 5 every 5 s at regen 10.
